faq.q: What is a titanium endoscope sheath?
faq.a: A titanium endoscope sheath is a precision-machined surgical instruments component used in rigid endoscope outer protective sheath. Manufactured from Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium endoscope sheath?
faq.a: Titanium Endoscope Sheath is designed for rigid endoscope outer protective sheath. The Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium endoscope sheath manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Endoscope Sheath is manufactured using VAR melting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium endoscope sheath?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
